comments.value:
Interesting. If you were to go to %AppData% in windows explorer, what can you share about where it takes you?

https://superuser.com/a/632893

Is the directory not on C? Is there any characters in the username other than like a-z and A-Z? Numbers are also probably fine.

If a regular build functions and the "build and test" fails, the only thing build and test does differently is copy a file into appdata/locallowlocallow/VRChat/VRChat

@{62df7cd83e007e467295c4e1|full_name}: My %AppData% is C:\Users\BUzer\AppData\Roaming

no weird symbols or anything like that

But I think I figured it out. All the avatars I tried to test recently have the '>' symbol in their game object names. The SDK uses these names as the file names for the avatars in the AppData folder. If I remove this  symbol the test build goes successfully.

So I guess it's still a bug that the SDK does not sanitize the file names.

details:
